Cards show name, description, and stars / "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"downloads; clicking a card opens the detail preview and install button."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Design Notes"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Why does the GitHub source have no per-skill stars?** A skill in that repo is a **directory**, not"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" a repository, so it has no independent star field. This plugin groups by collection and "},{"id":"p33s5","text":"shows the upstream repo's stars instead."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"**Network adaptation (China-friendly)**: `raw.githubusercontent.com` is frequently DNS-blocked in ma"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"inland China (fails with `ENOTFOUND`, and — worst of all — **throws no exception, it just returns em"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"pty data**, which is very hard to debug). | `clawhub.ai` | ClawHub skill registry & file contents |
| `api.skillhub."},{"id":"p40s3","text":"cn` | SkillHub skill registry & file contents |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Local writes are limited to:
- `~/.dsh/skills/` — target directory for installed skills
- `~/.dsh/sk"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"ill-store-cache/` — index cache"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**No telemetry, no data upload, no account or token required.** Setting the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environme"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"nt variable only raises the GitHub API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour; everything works f"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"y raises the GitHub API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour; everything works fine without it."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"- **Profile**: `web` (requires the web UI; in headless mode the UI is unavailable but the API endpoi"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"nts still work)
